Invalid Request Demonstrations

Nonexistent variable
[VALIDATION ERROR] Variable ‘misspelled_payment_column’ does not exist in the dataset. Please verify the column name.
Incorrect variable type
[VALIDATION ERROR] Variable ‘customer_city’ is of type ‘character’, but type ‘numeric’ was expected.
More than two groups
[VALIDATION ERROR] Grouping variable ‘order_status’ contains 8 groups (delivered, unavailable, shipped, canceled, invoiced, processing, approved, created). Exactly 2 groups are required for this analysis.
Missing required date
[VALIDATION ERROR] Date column ‘purchase_date’ contains only missing or empty values. Analysis cannot proceed.
Missing prediction input
[VALIDATION ERROR] Input variable ‘seller_count’ contains missing values (NA) which are not permitted during prediction.
Causal conclusion request
[VALIDATION ERROR] The conclusion statement contains causal words (cause, proves). Causal claims are prohibited on observational datasets; only associations can be inferred.

Recommendations

  1. Resolve delivered orders without delivery dates before reporting delivery KPIs.
  2. Annotate missing month 2016-11 and boundary months in trend analysis.
  3. Review payment differences above tolerance separately from item-plus-freight totals.
  4. Interpret seller delivery metrics cautiously when multi-seller orders share one delivery outcome.

Limitations

Programmatic checks validate structure and logical consistency but cannot detect courier mis-scans or unrecorded customer contacts. Outliers may represent legitimate high-value or long-distance orders.
